prompt:
Gentle storybook painterly illustration, realism about 3.5/5, soft gouache-and-oil brushwork, warm-hearted and calm, natural NEUTRAL daylight with true colours, off-white whites, no orange, sepia, amber or golden cast, no pink or blue tint, clear readable figures with contact shadows on the floor, consistent eye-level perspective, 16:9 wide composition.
Scene: Quartier de la Santé, outdoors. Camera: south edge of the square, eye level, facing north.
Setting: three facades around a calm square: B17 cream stone townhouse with sage-green shutters (left), B19 pale primrose-yellow stone hospital with a round heart-shaped window (back), B18 narrow pharmacy with a mortar-shaped copper dome (right); floor: pale grey cobbles with a ring of herb beds (lavender, mint, sage) round the fountain. Landmark: the Fontaine du Mortier: a big stone fountain shaped like a mortar and pestle, water spilling from the bowl, in the centre. Light: fresh late-morning spring daylight, soft shadows from two lime trees. The room feels lived-in and real, with depth (never an empty white backdrop).
Paint these exits clearly as walkable openings: B17 Cabinet médical's front door, cream stone townhouse on the LEFT (way to Le Cabinet médical); B19 Hôpital's big glazed entrance doors, BACK CENTRE (way to L'Hôpital); B18 Pharmacie's glazed shop door under its blank green-cross sign, RIGHT (way to La Pharmacie).
Also paint an airy lane with wind chimes opening at the FRONT LEFT corner (a street mouth).
Also paint a narrow apothecary lane between B17 and the hospital, BACK LEFT (a street mouth).
Also paint a tree-lined avenue leaving BACK RIGHT beside the hospital (a street mouth).
Also paint a rose-hedged arch at the FRONT RIGHT corner (a street mouth).
Leave a blank light board for the room sign high on the back wall. No written words, letters, numbers or logos anywhere (signs and plaques are blank boards). No blood, no wounds, no needles in skin (syringes only as capped harmless props), no alcohol, no smoking, no religious symbols, no red-cross emblem. Nobody cropped by the image edge; keep every figure well inside the frame with a clear gap between figures. Figures stand on the floor or sit on real furniture, never floating or in rows behind a counter.
prompt_note: 'prompt' is the generation record; the setting text above describes the painting as installed (round oculus, green-glass porch; no heart-shaped window).
